name_zh: 庇隆/阿根廷/工人/埃维塔/石油/流亡/回归/胡安/埃维塔
description_zh: 胡安·庇隆 (1895-1974) 阿根廷总统 (1946-1955, 1973-1974) 庇隆主义创始人，推行工人权益和民族主义，1938年流亡，1973年回归，爱妻埃维塔·庇隆是他的政治伴侣，被誉为现代阿根廷的缔造者。
description_en: Juan Peron (1895-1974) Argentine President (1946-1955, 1973-1974) founder of Peronism, promoted workers' rights and nationalism, exiled in 1938, returned in 1973, his wife Evita Peron was his political companion, known as the architect of modern Argentina.
reason_zh: 庇隆代表了拉美如何通过民族主义和工人权益推动社会改革，以及如何通过流亡和回归实现政治理想，体现了拉美右翼民粹主义的典型特征。
reason_en: Peron represents how Latin American promotes nationalism and workers' rights to promote social reform, achieves political ideals through exile and return, embodies typical characteristics of Latin American right-wing populism.
